 "rationale": "A 1.57 V swing needs a rail-to-rail common-source output, so a 5T-OTA will not work. The budget is 10 uA ref + 8 uA tail + 38 uA stage 2, which gives about 101 uW. The input pair runs at gm/Id 17 with large area for low flicker noise. A small Cc of about 0.5 pF gives a GBW of about 21 MHz. Rz is set to (1/gm6)(1+CL/Cc) so that its LHP zero cancels p2, which gives the 70 deg PM. Long-L loads and a long-L tail set the gain, CMRR and PSRR."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),       # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),          # input pair L (area for flicker)
    "Itail": (8e-6, 6e-6, 12e-6),      # first-stage tail current
    "I2":    (38e-6, 28e-6, 42e-6),    # second-stage current
    "gmidp": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),        # PMOS load / CS gm/Id (matched density)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),          # PMOS load / CS L
    "gmidn": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),        # NMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),          # NMOS mirror L
    "Cc":    (0.5e-12, 0.3e-12, 0.9e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),          # Rz scale vs ideal pole-zero cancellation
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I2, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I2"], p["Cc"]

    # NMOS bias: ibias diode, tail and second-stage sink all at the same density
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # input pair: source sits near 0.35 V, drain near 0.8 V
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)

    # PMOS mirror load and CS second stage share one current density (low systematic offset)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # Rz places the LHP zero on p2 = gm6/CL
    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1.0 / m6.gm) * (1.0 + cl / Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinn on the diode side, vinp on the output side -> vinp is non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    g1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    g2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(g1 * g2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m6.gm / (2 * PI * cl)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)) if Rz > 1.0 / m6.gm else 1e12
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m3.cgd
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * c1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I2)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vth_n = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise_1k = 4.0 * vth_n    # rough flicker allowance on top of the thermal floor
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.05
    cmrr_db = db(2 * m1.gm * m3.gm / (m5.gds * (m1.gds + m3.gds)) / 2)
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db}
